stories.title: Russell Brand
stories.summary: English actor Russell Brand is sentenced to 10 years and 6 months imprisonment for one rape and three counts of sexual assault.
stories.about: Russell Edward Brand is an English comedian, actor and media personality. He rose to prominence as a reality television presenter in the early 2000s before starring in major comedy films, releasing several stand-up specials and hosting radio shows. In 2026, he was convicted of rape and sexual assault, and sentenced to 10 years and six months in prison.

stories.title: 2026 Kraków shooting
stories.summary: The 24-year-old man responsible for the drive-by mass shooting at the Main Square in Kraków, Poland, two days ago, which killed six people and injured 16 others, dies at a hospital after being seriously wounded in a shootout with police.
stories.about: On 7 November 2026, a mass shooting took place in Kraków, Poland, when 24-year-old Michał Oksiński opened fire from his car as he drove through the Main Square, killing six people and injuring 16 others before being shot by police. Following the shooting, police discovered the dead bodies of three members of his family in their apartment in Ostrowiec Świętokrzyski. Oksiński later died in a hospital in Kraków. His motives remain under investigation.
